title: prunus × lannesiana f. affinis
intro: Prunus × lannesiana f. affinis, commonly known as the Chinese Rose or Double Cherry, is a hybrid plant species within the Prunus genus. It is prized for its ornamental value, with showy, double-petaled flowers and attractive foliage. The plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Prunus × lannesiana f. affinis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects.
